query:
SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS "rows!",
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM federated_identities g
                    WHERE g.issuer = $2 AND g.external_sub = f.external_sub
                      AND g.user_id = f.user_id
                )) AS "same_user!",
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM federated_identities g
                    WHERE g.issuer = $2 AND g.external_sub = f.external_sub
                      AND g.user_id <> f.user_id
                )) AS "conflicting!"
            FROM federated_identities f
            WHERE f.issuer = ANY($1)
